{{External|rs|rsc=Black battle Axe}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black battleaxe |image = [[File:Black battleaxe.png]] |release = [[8 December]] [[2001]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (8 December 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A vicious looking axe. |value = 1248 |weight = 2.721 |exchange = Yes |id = 1367 }} [[File:Black battleaxe detail.png|left|130px]] The '''black battleaxe''' is a [[battleaxe]] stronger than the [[steel battleaxe]], but weaker than the [[Mithril battleaxe]]. It requires 10 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can purchase this battleaxe from [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]] in [[Port Sarim]]. It can also be received as a drop from a [[Dark beast]], and as a reward from a beginner [[clue scroll]] or easy [[clue scroll]]. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black battleaxe cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = -2 |aslash = +20 |acrush = +15 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = -1 |str = +24 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 6 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Axe |image = [[File:Black battleaxe equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Black battleaxe equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Axe|speed=6|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black battleaxe}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black battleaxe}} ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black battleaxe detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black battleaxe detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black battleaxe (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black battleaxe.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
